posts.author: castlemaniac
posts.body:
Hi again! I was wondering if GIFs or animated images could be added in RPG Maker MV for specific battles (if not all)? We've tried adding some but the engine can't really read them properly. For context, I'm looking for something similar like Mother / Earthbound's Giygas battle or anything like that.
There is this
thread
, but it only specifies that it can be used in events, and I wanted to be doubly sure if it can also be applied in some way in battles or is only limited to the last one mentioned.
Is there any plugins needed also to achieve this?, anything will help! Sorry if this might be repetitive, I just wish to make sure if there is anything else we can try. Thank you!
